description: This file implements Google OAuth authentication endpoints for a FastAPI application, including login URL generation, token exchange, ID token verification, user creation, and token issuance.

classes.name: OneTapRequest
classes.description: Pydantic model representing the payload from Google Identity Services One Tap, containing a credential string.

methods.name: _verify_google_id_token
methods.description: Verifies a Google ID token, ensuring issuer, audience, and email verification, returning token info if valid.

methods.name: _find_or_create_user
methods.description: Finds a user by email or creates a new user with Google provider, generating a placeholder password hash.

methods.name: google_login
methods.description: Builds and returns the Google OAuth authorization URL for user redirection.

methods.name: google_callback
methods.description: Handles OAuth callback: exchanges code for tokens, verifies ID token, finds/creates user, and issues app tokens.

methods.name: google_one_tap
methods.description: Verifies Google One Tap ID token and issues application tokens.
